Results.ReviewText:
Since receiving delivery of my Weber grill order on August 25th, it’s been an unfortunate ordeal of patience working with Weber's Customer Service team. First, it was replacing a damaged grill cover and cook-box parts that were “intentionally” packed that way – which the Customer Service team did timely respond and send the proper replacement parts. Hence a two star rating and not a one.

However, while initially assembling the grill’s undercarriage, we also discovered two or three support parts (we didn’t know which was/were wrong) that failed to properly and securely connect/assemble.

After almost four weeks of back and forth with Weber's Customer Service team about obtaining the correct carriage assembly part(s) – each of their responses resulting in either sending the same, identical wrong part(s) (“what is the definition of insanity?”) – I finally surrendered and initiated a purchase return and refund with Amazon (the distributing retailer).

Its an Iconic brand of products I've been using since the late 70s. However, while their products may seem innovative, it feels as if their overall quality control has slipped...
Results.Title: Frustrating Customer Service, Quality Control
